purpose: native symmetry-quotient frontier calibration and exploratory exact residue search

full.partition: group i runs logical shards 2*i and 2*i+1 independently for both patterns

portable_certificate_contract.priority: test full exponent-difference collisions between every required two-term row and every mixed binomial before constructing the HNF lattice
portable_certificate_contract.exception_rule: preserve every support whose exact outcome is not covered by a missing required amplitude or a unit signed path/cycle of length at most five

scientific_outcome_table.open_support: preserve the exact support and subject it to independent private coefficient replay before any feasibility claim
scientific_outcome_table.zero_open_supports: exploratory evidence only; extract portable lattice certificates and an independent complete semantic verifier before a size-20 theorem
scientific_outcome_table.technical_incomplete: reject missing, duplicate, deadline, signal, cap, identity, or coverage failures and diagnose before retry

scope_boundary: the run searches the first open common-matrix support size; it neither bounds larger supports nor proves the full target statement
